paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.38b.6): he came to the Exilarch’s house, and Rav Zevid said to them: “Do not listen to him,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: Rav Zevid tells the people at the Exilarch’s house to disregard Rabbi Chiyya’s ruling. Zevid then cites Abaye in support of Rabbi Yochanan.
